verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Sandboxes provides VM-isolated, ephemeral execution environments with their own filesystem, exec, and network access, explicitly separate from production infra — ideal for AI agents to test code/commands without touching real systems (docs-24, docs-34, docs-38). Persistent storage (R2/S3 mounts, snapshots) is opt-in, keeping test runs isolated by default. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that data truly never leaks into production, and clearer docs on isolation guarantees for outbound network calls (community notes lack of granular egress control, docs-comm-2).
